sentences.text: Christopher Scott Kyle -LRB- April 8 , 1974 − February 2 , 2013 -RRB- was a United States Navy SEAL veteran and sniper .	United States Navy SEAL	United States Navy SEAL
Kyle served four tours in the Iraq War and was awarded several commendations for acts of heroism and meritorious service in combat .	Iraq War	Iraq War

He was awarded one Silver Star Medal , four Bronze Star Medals with `` V '' devices , a Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal and numerous other unit and personal awards .	Silver Star Medal	Silver Star Medal	Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal	Achievement Medal	V	"V" Device	Achievement Medal	Achievement Medal

Kyle was honorably discharged from the U.S. Navy in 2009 and published his bestselling autobiography , American Sniper , in 2012 .	American Sniper	American Sniper (book)	honorably discharged	honorably discharged
An eponymous film adaptation of Kyle 's book , directed by Clint Eastwood , was released two years later .	eponymous film adaptation	American Sniper	Clint Eastwood	Clint Eastwood
On February 2 , 2013 , Kyle was murdered by Eddie Ray Routh at a shooting range near Chalk Mountain , Texas .
A former Marine with PTSD , Routh was found guilty and sentenced to life in prison without parole .
